The Truth About Immigration ... 

Big nations complain about immigrants but forget they are often part of the cause.

Video

What If Strict Borders Made Things Worse?

There was a time when crossing the border wasn’t about staying forever…
People would come, work, and go back home.

And in doing that, they didn’t just help one country, they helped both.

So what changed?

And what if the system we think is “stronger”…
is actually making things worse?

👉 Watch the full episode for the full conversation.

#Immigration #GlobalIssues #Humanity #Dignity #Politics #Impact #Leadership

Video

Big countries complain about immigrants coming in…
but rarely ask why they’re leaving in the first place.

What if the same systems creating opportunity in one place are creating pressure somewhere else?

People don’t just leave home for no reason.
🌎🤔

#Immigration #GlobalIssues #Humanity #whatnowpodcast

Video

We all like to think we’re too smart to be brainwashed, but mind control isn’t about being 'weak'; it’s about how our biology is being hacked. 

I sat down with Steven Hassan to discuss how these systems actually work and why nobody is truly immune. 

Check out the full conversation on the WhatNow Podcast.

I’ve barely had Taco Bell in my life... Don't Judge me. 😂

But the point is, the ads don’t work on me.
My brain’s like, "We don’t do that here.”

Meanwhile, show me ice cream once and I’m already in the car.

There is a reason for that...

What if the problem isn’t your focus… but what you’ve been practicing your whole life?

We’ve trained our brains to jump between apps, notifications, and distractions, and now we think something is “wrong” with us.

This completely flipped how I see productivity, attention, and even ADHD.

👉 If this hit you, the full conversation goes WAY deeper. Watch the full episode on YouTube.
